Driven by purpose

AI does the heavy lifting — people make the calls.

Influencer marketing used to mean spreadsheets, guesswork and gut feel. We built IMAI so any team — from a solo founder to a global enterprise — can find the right creators, prove the return, and pay fairly, all in one place.

Today we index 400M+ creators, screen them for authenticity, and connect discovery to activation and ROI. The result: shorter shortlists, better fits, and fewer expensive mistakes.
